• Types of wrinkles and treatment methods
  • What causes wrinkles and fine lines? Is there a relationship between food and bone structure?
  • Measures and prevention methods for wrinkles and fine lines
  • Treatment methods to erase fine lines
  • Flow of wrinkle and nasolabial fold treatment performed at our hospital
  • Frequently asked questions about wrinkle treatment
  • What is sagging? Symptom check, causes and improvement methods
  • Treatment method for “sagging” at our hospital

Types of wrinkles and treatment methods

Fine wrinkles, dry wrinkles, crepe wrinkles

Both are fine wrinkles that appear on the epidermis.
The main cause is dry skin. It is more likely to occur in areas that lack sebaceous glands and tend to dry out, such as around the eyes.

Recommended treatment

Photo facial, derma pen,hyaluronic acid injection、water light injection

Facial wrinkles

These are wrinkles that deepen due to repeated facial expressions such as smiling or angry. It tends to appear between the eyebrows and at the corners of the eyes.
The cause is the repeated movements of facial muscles, but if your skin is dry to begin with, wrinkles are more likely to form.

Recommended treatment

botox injection

Deep wrinkles (such as nasolabial folds)

These are wrinkles that occur deep within the skin, in the dermis.
The main cause is that the skin loses its elasticity and firmness due to a decrease in collagen and a lack of elastin in the dermis.

Recommended treatment

photo facial, rejuran injection,hyaluronic acid injection

wrinkles and wrinkles

These wrinkles, such as nasolabial folds and golgo lines, occur unrelated to the movement of facial muscles.
The main causes include a decline in skin elasticity and firmness due to aging, and a rapid decrease in subcutaneous fat.

Recommended treatment

hyaluronic acid injection

Sagging wrinkles

These are wrinkles that occur beneath the sagging skin.
Sagging skin is caused by aging, UV rays, and an increase in subcutaneous fat due to lack of exercise.

Recommended treatment

HIFU、thread lift

What causes wrinkles and fine lines? Is there a relationship between food and bone structure?

Cause of wrinkles

aging

As we age, our skin becomes thinner, collagen, elastin, and hyaluronic acid decrease, metabolism slows, and muscles weaken, making wrinkles more likely to occur.

ultraviolet light

UV rays reach the dermis and damage collagen, elastin, and fibroblasts. This causes the skin to become loose and wrinkles appear.

drying

When the barrier function decreases due to dryness, it becomes more susceptible to the effects of ultraviolet rays.
It also makes wrinkles more likely.

stress

Hormones secreted by strong stress lead to a decline in the skin's barrier function and slowdown of metabolism, making it more likely to cause not only wrinkles but also rough skin and sagging skin.

disordered lifestyle habits

A nutritionally unbalanced diet, lack of sleep and exercise can slow down your metabolism and inhibit the production of collagen, leading to wrinkles and age spots.

Is the skeleton and muscles the cause of deep nasolabial folds?

hollows in the skeleton and bones

If there is less protrusion of the original facial skeleton and bones around the nostrils, nasolabial folds are more likely to form. This is a type of nasolabial folds that is especially common among Asians.

Weakness of the muscles that make facial expressions

As facial muscles weaken, their ability to support the cheeks decreases, leading to deeper nasolabial folds.

Sagging mouth and cheeks due to aging

When your mouth and skin sag as you age, the underlying smile lines become deeper.

Decrease in collagen in the dermis

When collagen in the dermis decreases, firmness and elasticity are lost, resulting in deeper nasolabial folds.

Measures and prevention methods for wrinkles and fine lines

UV protection

UV rays cause a decrease in collagen and elastin.
Regardless of the season, it is important to take measures against UV rays by wearing sunscreen, hats, parasols, sunglasses, etc.

skin care

Skin care that moisturizes and normalizes skin turnover is effective for preventing epidermal wrinkles, and skin care that supplements collagen and elastin is effective for preventing dermal wrinkles.
However, with regard to collagen, high effects cannot be expected from external supplementation.

Use and train facial muscles

Facial muscles can be trained just like the muscles of the body through use.
There are exercises such as saying "a-i-u-e-o" while moving the mouth loudly. It is also effective to chew your meals thoroughly, and chew not only soft foods but also hard foods.

Improving lifestyle habits

Make sure to eat a nutritionally balanced diet, get enough sleep in both quantity and quality, and exercise moderately.
You can expect effects such as normalizing metabolism and promoting collagen production.

Treatment methods to erase fine lines

Hyaluronic acid injection

Hyaluronic acid injections are recommended for improving fine lines.
By directly injecting hyaluronic acid, which naturally exists in the body, the elasticity and firmness of the skin is restored, and fine lines become thinner.
You can feel the effects immediately after injection. The effect lasts for about six months to a year.

About hyaluronic acid injection

Flow of wrinkle and nasolabial fold treatment performed at our hospital

1counseling

Our staff and doctors will provide counseling and listen to your concerns and wishes.
We will check your bone structure, skin condition, etc.
We will also explain side effects, risks, downtime, precautions, etc.

2face wash

You will be asked to wash your face to remove makeup, sebum, dirt, etc.

3hyaluronic acid injection

Inject hyaluronic acid.
There is almost no pain as it contains an anesthetic.

4Go home

After checking your smile lines and skin condition, you can go home.

Frequently asked questions about wrinkle treatment

Are injections such as Botox and hyaluronic acid painful?

Since it is an injection, you will inevitably experience a tingling pain when the needle is inserted. At our clinic, we strive to minimize pain as much as possible by using ultra-fine needles and numbing cream.

How long does the effect of wrinkle treatment last?

It depends on the treatment. The recommended treatment time is 3 to 4 months for Botox injections, and 6 months to 1 year for hyaluronic acid injections.
*There are individual differences.

What should I do to maintain wrinkle-free skin?

First of all, be aware that the causes of wrinkles are UV rays, dryness, stress, and poor lifestyle habits, and take countermeasures for each. However, aging also causes wrinkles, so it is difficult to maintain wrinkle-free skin with just aging.
Our clinic offers a wide range of wrinkle prevention options, so please consult with us before wrinkles form or deepen.

What is sagging? Symptom check, causes and improvement methods

Are you having trouble with these symptoms?

  • face is sagging
  • Concerned about bags and wrinkles under the eyes
  • You look older and tired because of sagging skin.
  • Sagging skin creates shadows under the eyes

What causes sagging? Using your smartphone for a long time is also a cause! ?

Decreased skin elasticity

From around the age of 30, the amount of collagen and elastin in the dermis decreases, making it easier for the skin to sag.

Weakness of facial muscles

Facial muscles also weaken, mainly due to aging. The skin and subcutaneous fat can no longer be supported, causing sagging.

Increase in subcutaneous fat

This is sagging caused by an increase in subcutaneous fat due to age-related decline in basal metabolism, obesity, etc.

bad posture that lasts for a long time

Poor posture, such as sticking your head forward or looking down for long periods of time, can impede the flow of lymph and blood, causing waste products to accumulate. This makes it easier for swelling to occur, which also appears on your face.
In recent years, it has been pointed out that using smartphones and mobile games for long periods of time is also a cause of sagging skin.

How to improve sagging yourself

skin care

Skin care that focuses on moisturizing protects your skin from dryness and maintains its elasticity. Moisturizing also maintains the barrier function, making it less susceptible to UV rays.

UV protection

Use sunscreen, hats, parasols, sunglasses, etc. to protect yourself from UV rays throughout the year, even in seasons other than summer.
Ultraviolet rays damage collagen and elastin, causing skin problems such as sagging and age spots.

train facial muscles

Train your facial muscles by doing exercises such as uttering things like "a-i-u-e-o" while moving your mouth loudly.
Facial muscles, like the muscles of the body, can be prevented and improved by training them.

Improving lifestyle habits

Improve your lifestyle to maintain and improve your basal metabolism. Avoid overeating and exercise moderately. Getting enough sleep is also important for preventing and improving other skin problems.

Treatment method for “sagging” at our hospital

High (HIFU)

HIFU (High Intensity Focused Ultrasound) is a treatment that focuses ultrasound waves on one point to achieve a pinpoint lifting effect. Ultrasonic thermal energy is delivered to two layers: the SMAS layer, which is 4.5 mm below the skin, and the dermal layer, which is 3 mm below the skin.
You can expect to improve sagging, make your face smaller, and improve your skin quality without using a scalpel.

About HIFU

thread lift

This treatment involves passing special medical threads under the skin to improve sagging skin.
At our hospital, we use a thread called N-COG, which has a large number of protrusions and is highly flexible and stretchable.
You can get a firm lifting effect while suppressing discomfort and pain.

About lift up

photo facial

This treatment uses IPL (Intense Pulsed Light) to irradiate the face to improve a wide range of skin problems such as sagging, fine lines, age spots, freckles, acne, acne scars, and dullness.
Our hospital uses the latest photofacial "M22" from Luminous. Seven types of IPL can be applied, so choose the appropriate wavelength depending on your skin concerns and condition.

About photofacial

derma pen

This is a treatment that uses needles thinner than a hair to temporarily create extremely small holes in the skin to improve the natural healing power and improve skin problems.
By creating a state where the skin is reborn, it promotes collagen secretion and improves metabolism, improving sagging, enlarged pores, acne scars, fine wrinkles, etc.

water light injection

This skin beautifying treatment was born in South Korea, a beauty powerhouse.
A beauty ingredient whose main ingredient is non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid, which has high moisturizing properties, is injected into your face using an ultra-fine needle. You can customize the beauty ingredients by adding vitamin C, placenta, CoQ10, etc.
By improving skin moisture and firmness and promoting collagen production, you can expect to improve not only sagging skin but also fine lines and fine lines.

About water light injection

hyaluronic acid injection

Hyaluronic acid, which naturally exists in our bodies and has excellent moisturizing properties, is injected directly into the areas of concern.
It can be expected to restore moisture and firmness to the skin, and improve sagging and wrinkles.
Another appeal of hyaluronic acid injections is that you can feel the effects immediately after the treatment.

About hyaluronic acid injection
